[IMG_2] = main character

Shot 2 (3s): Medium shot, [IMG_2] main action from the grid, static, eye-level, motion intensity 1.0. Cut.
Shot 3 (3s): Close-up, key detail or expression from the grid, slow pull out, eye-level, motion intensity 0.5. Cut.
Shot 4 (3s): Medium shot, tension or movement beat from the grid, handheld, low angle, motion intensity 1.6. Cut.
Shot 5 (3s): Wide shot, final beat from the grid, crane down, high angle, motion intensity 0.7.

Negative prompt: motion blur, temporal flicker, identity drift, deformed hands, inconsistent lighting direction, background drift, warping, compression artifacts.
